description: Serce Pnia, the living heart of the World Tree: a huge anatomical heart shape made of polished dark red-brown heartwood, rings of tree growth on its surface, thick root-like arteries on top full of glowing golden sap, glowing golden sap veins pulsing across it, one deep glowing amber eye-like knot, no arms, no legs, floating and beating, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the heart alone, no tree, no ground, no background, the whole heart inside the picture
